content.short: ChainAware.ai uses predictive wallet analytics to score fraud risk, behavior, and trust across networks including TON.
content.description: ChainAware.ai is a wallet intelligence platform built around predictive analytics rather than simple address labeling. Its official products for users and teams include Wallet Auditor, Fraud Detector, Wallet Rank, behavioral prediction tools, and AI agents that consume those signals through web interfaces, APIs, and MCP workflows. The platform says it evaluates millions of wallet profiles and uses behavioral data to score fraud probability, experience, intent, and related trust signals. For TON, it fits best as a wallet risk and analytics layer rather than a payment, trading, or custody product.
content.meta: See ChainAware.ai, a predictive wallet analytics platform for fraud scoring, behavioral signals, trust analysis, and TON support.
